global: This shoyu broth, golden-brown and glossy, floats with noodles and green onions. In a white ceramic bowl with red rim and green speckles, tender chashu pork and dark green nori sit beside a white ceramic spoon on a wooden table.

regions.background: Wooden table surface shows light brown grain pattern with subtle texture and natural wood finish.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with red rim, green speckles, and red "ARASAKI" text, smooth surface with slight sheen.
regions.soup: The shoyu (soy sauce) broth is golden-brown, glossy, and contains visible noodles and green onions floating on its surface.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, rectangular, with visible surface details and slight curling edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows tender, pale pink meat with visible fat marbling and slightly uneven surface texture.
